paragraphs.text: Our mission at Lakeshore Orthodontics is to deliver personalized, compassionate care in a friendly, family-oriented setting where every patient feels valued and heard.

We believe that orthodontic treatment should be accessible, comfortable, and tailored to each individual's unique needs and lifestyle. Our commitment extends beyond creating beautiful smileswe focus on building lasting relationships with our patients and their families.
We offer a variety of treatment optionsincluding braces and Invisalign

Through advanced technology, gentle techniques, and flexible scheduling, we make quality orthodontic care achievable for everyone in our community, ensuring each patient leaves with not just a perfect smile, but also the confidence to share it with the world.

image.alt: Dr. Jessica De Rose smiling in her Lakeshore Orthodontics treatment room

paragraphs.text: Dr. Jessica De Rose DDS, MS, FRCD is excited to be the newest member of the Orthodontics team. Born and raised in Windsor, Ontario, she has shared a passion for dentistry and orthodontics since starting high school at Holy Names. Going through treatment herself, she naturally developed an appreciation for the field and wanted to share the experience with others by providing the utmost care for them.
With a passion for crafting beautiful smiles and a commitment to delivering exceptional patient care, Dr. De Rose brings fresh enthusiasm and a strong educational background to the practice.

image.alt: Dr. Jessica De Rose smiling in her Lakeshore Orthodontics treatment room

paragraphs.text: After graduating from the University of Windsor with a major in Biological Sciences, she pursued her lifelong dream at the University of Detroit Mercy obtaining her Doctor of Dental Surgery degree. Being both inquisitive and spirited, Dr. De Rose decided to expand her horizons by venturing to Kentucky to complete her Orthodontic speciality training at the University of Louisville, where she received both her Certificate and Master of Science Degree.

image.alt: Dr. Jessica De Rose smiling in her Lakeshore Orthodontics treatment room

paragraphs.text: In her spare time Dr. De Rose enjoys spending time with family and friends, travelling the world, and helping others achieve their health and wellness goals as a certified personal fitness trainer. Dr. De Rose looks forward to giving back to the community one smile at a time.

image.alt: Dr. Jessica De Rose smiling in her Lakeshore Orthodontics treatment room

paragraphs.text: At your complimentary consultation you’ll meet with our treatment coordinator and one of our doctors. Photos will be taken and the doctor will evaluate your orthodontic needs, review treatment options, and explain what to expect and an estimated timeline.

After the consultation we’ll schedule your first appointment to place the appliance, which generally takes about an hour. We’ll work with you to find convenient follow-up times, typically every four to eight weeks.

image.alt: Parent and child at the reception desk of an orthodontic office

paragraphs.text: The cost of orthodontic treatment varies depending on your individual needs and treatment plan. Our team will review treatment cost and available payment plan options so you know what to expect before beginning care.

We accept most major credit cards and insurance plans. If your dental plan covers orthodontics, our staff can assist with claims and paperwork. Ask the front desk about online account access, payment history, and FSA reimbursement support.
Please take a minute to print and fill out the patient information form before your first appointment, or submit your information securely online using our patient forms portal.

image.alt: Patient completing orthodontic health history forms online

paragraphs.text: Early treatment, often called Phase One, typically begins around age eight or nine. The goal is to guide jaw growth, correct bite problems, create room for permanent teeth, and reduce the need for extractions or more invasive care later on.

Watch for signs that an early evaluation is recommended. These include early or late loss of baby teeth, difficulty chewing or biting, mouth breathing, persistent thumb‑sucking past age five, speech concerns, protruding teeth or an abnormal bite, and crowding of the front teeth around seven or eight years old.
Addressing growth and bite issues early can make later treatment shorter and less complex, and in some cases it prevents surgical or extraction-based solutions.

image.alt: Young patient receiving early orthodontic intervention
Smiling family enjoying time together

paragraphs.text: Adults have the same treatment options as younger patients, but their jaws have finished growing. That means plans are tailored to unique needs, which may include managing gum recession, restoring worn or missing teeth, or finishing prior treatment.

When jaw alignment cannot be corrected with orthodontics alone, orthognathic surgery may be an option. We offer discreet choices such as Invisalign<sup>®</sup>, clear ceramic braces, or low‑profile metal braces to suit adult lifestyles.
Common reasons include improving bite function, reducing risk of gum disease and tooth wear, and enhancing facial balance. We create a plan that fits your goals and daily life.

image.alt: Adult patient receiving orthodontic treatment
Adult patient receiving orthodontic treatment

Treatments.title: Braces — Traditional, Self‑ligating, and Clear Options

paragraphs.text: Braces remain a reliable solution for many orthodontic needs. Modern materials make them more comfortable and discreet, and options include traditional metal braces, self‑ligating systems that can reduce friction, and ceramic brackets for a less visible look. Treatment time typically ranges from one to three years depending on complexity.
Durable and cost‑effective, metal braces use brackets and wires to move teeth predictably.

image.alt: Dental Checkup with Braces

paragraphs.text: Ceramic brackets blend with tooth color for a subtler appearance while still delivering effective tooth movement.

image.alt: Smiling Woman with Clear Aligner
Two stylish smiling teens taking selfie with braces

paragraphs.text: We are a certified Invisalign provider. Invisalign aligners use SmartTrack® material and SmartForce® features to move teeth precisely and comfortably. Aligners are nearly invisible, removable for eating and hygiene, and typically require periodic visits about every six weeks.

Digital scanning with devices like iTero creates a 3D treatment plan and a visual preview of projected results. Invisalign can address many issues including crowding, spacing, overbites, crossbites, and gapped teeth.

image.alt: Close-up of Invisalign aligners being placed on teeth

paragraphs.text: Surgical orthodontics is recommended when jaw growth is complete and a correct bite cannot be achieved with orthodontics alone. Treatment is coordinated with an oral and maxillofacial surgeon and typically includes braces before and after surgery to position the teeth.
Surgery is performed in a hospital and recovery usually requires around two weeks of rest. Braces often remain in place for six to twelve months after surgery while final adjustments are completed.

image.alt: Orthodontic patient receiving orthognathic surgical consultation

Treatments.title: Retainers — Keeping Your Smile in Place

paragraphs.text: After active treatment, retainers hold teeth in their new positions while bone and soft tissues stabilize. We offer removable options, including clear Essix‑style retainers, and fixed bonded retainers when low maintenance is preferred.

Each option has pros and cons: removable retainers are easy to clean but can be misplaced, while fixed retainers require special flossing but are nearly invisibly secure. We’ll recommend the best choice for long‑term stability.

image.alt: Beautiful young Asian woman smiling and holding orthodontic retainer

Treatments.title: Technology that Improves Comfort, Accuracy, and Outcomes

paragraphs.text: We use digital tools to improve precision, comfort, and predictability. Digital scanning, 3D treatment planning, and high‑resolution imaging help us design efficient, comfortable treatment and preview likely outcomes.
No goop or putty — iTero captures accurate 3D impressions in minutes. Scans improve fit for aligners and let patients preview outcomes.

image.alt: iTero digital scanner in use during orthodontic consultation

paragraphs.text: Adjunctive tools such as light therapy devices may be offered to support tooth movement alongside aligner therapy. We can discuss whether these are appropriate for your plan.

image.alt: Digital X-ray equipment showing detailed orthodontic imaging

paragraphs.text: Advanced software simulates stages of tooth movement, helping us plan precisely and show you a virtual preview of your smile transformation.

image.alt: 3D treatment planning software showing orthodontic simulation
Modern dentist office interior with advanced technology

paragraphs.text: Answers to our most common customer questions about products, orders, returns, shipping, and support. If you do not find what you need, contact our team and we will help.

accordion.header: How do I place an order?

paragraphs.text: Browse our products online, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Enter shipping and payment details and submit your order. You will receive a confirmation email with your order summary and next steps.

image.alt: Shipping box ready for dispatch

accordion.header: What payment methods do you accept?

paragraphs.text: We accept major credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal. For large or corporate orders, contact our sales team for invoice or alternative payment arrangements.

image.alt: Close-up of credit card and payment terminal

accordion.header: What is your return and refund policy?

paragraphs.text: Items may be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are in original condition. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days after we receive and inspect the return.

image.alt: Package with return label being prepared

paragraphs.text: Standard shipping typically takes 3 to 7 business days. Expedited options are available at checkout and usually arrive within 1 to 3 business days. Orders are generally processed within one business day.

image.alt: Packages moving through a shipping facility

accordion.header: How do I track my order?

paragraphs.text: After your order ships, you will receive an email with a tracking number. Use that number on the carrier's website to follow delivery progress, or visit our Order Status page and enter your order number and email address.

image.alt: Person checking shipment tracking on a mobile phone

accordion.header: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?

paragraphs.text: Use the 'Forgot password' link on the sign-in page. We will send a password reset link to your email that is valid for 60 minutes. Follow the link to choose a new password and regain access.

image.alt: User resetting password on a laptop

paragraphs.text: Yes. Many products include a one-year limited warranty. Extended warranty options are available at checkout or by contacting customer service for details and eligibility.

image.alt: Warranty certificate on a desk

accordion.header: How do I contact customer support?

paragraphs.text: For general inquiries use our Contact page or email support@yourdomain.com. For urgent issues call our support line during business hours. We respond to web inquiries within one business day.

image.alt: Support agent with headset ready to assist

accordion.header: Do you offer appointments or installations?

paragraphs.text: Yes. In-person appointments and installations are available in select regions. Schedule online via our Appointments page or contact support to confirm availability in your area.

image.alt: Technician preparing for an on-site appointment

accordion.header: Where can I find your full FAQ?
